parameters.description: Sort field. Omit for the default order: role precedence (workspace_owner, workspace_admin, workspace_editor, external_collaborator, workspace_viewer), then most recently joined; with query set, best matches first. name sorts case-insensitively by the returned name, with null names first ascending and last descending. display_name is an alias for name, with identical ordering and interchangeable cursors. joined_at falls back to the invitation time. role sorts by role precedence. relevance ranks by match score and requires query; ties break by most recent join.
